rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Open Siddur Project logo, 2014. The Open Siddur Project logo was adapted from Johannes Itten's "Farbkreis" (1961), <http://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Farbkreis_Itten_1961.svg>. The text inside the color wheel reads סידוּר in Hebrew script.
